folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B427: memory and crowd receipt supersession
folds.body:
Scoped evidence maintenance of the existing memory/crowd design owner; this append is not a complete reread of the systems design or a new accepted rule.

**MR4:** The initial silence-only browser floor is superseded in wave2 by shown severity/loyalty/debt/claim lines and threat/oath/cover-story routes. Derived severity and loyalty tables retain world defaults and evidence-based guess/test status; schema2is written only for actual silence/claim data so untouched schema1saves remain unchanged. Claims beside facts are epistemic accounts, distinct from ownership claim effects. Silence uses stable holder/topic/listener/30day keys and reasons, not a universal chance cap or promise guarantee. Browser day1–7and one-seed route outcomes do not establish45day behavior: long fast-forward still crashes. Forty-two of60versus16of60is the synthetic multi-root comparison, not the one-seed Chrome result. Wave2commands and displayed debt do not prove debt-driven action, revenge goals, authority timing or delayed discovery. Focused/native memory persistence passes coexist with failed/queued full suites; exclusion by inspection is not clean-tree causal proof. Later MR5 closes a specific fight memory hook, not all fight/silence integration.

**MR5:** Crowds remain derived counts with named-cast subtraction, world-swappable density/roles and keyed reactions conserving heads. Promotion IDs are independent of other heads/play order; persisted witness episodes and group impressions use memory owners. The same pre-scene save yields the same witness/count across fresh origins, whereas different life seeds may legitimately differ. Initial village browser/save/import evidence does not implement testimony commands, helping/fetching/authority arrival or shields. The final addendum explicitly supersedes the prepared native_battle patch: the actual fight hook lands in tempo_fight and a real road contest writes witness/group/fighter memories, preserved after literal import. It still lacks a road witness screen and writes one episode per damaging strike (26retainedwithin40cap); later folding is a proposal, not lossless-history proof or permission to discard useful detail. Failed fullsuite4519pass/14fail remains failed despite86focused passes and inspected unrelated paths. Preserve both initial bounds and later actual hook owner.

The later calibration-domain table describes harness/strain coverage, so its documented-only relationship/crowd rows do not negate these narrow historical village/fight browser routes. Conversely those routes do not supply a domain calibration harness, every world or present-checkout verification. Preserve this distinction and the dated failures; no new gameplay, population policy or memory truncation decision is made here.
